checks.quote: Basic Authentication sends your API Key and API Secret Base64-encoded in the Authorization header. You can find these credentials in your API settings in the Vonage Dashboard.
Generate a JWT signed with your Application ID and private key. You can use the JWT Generator, the Vonage CLI, or any Vonage SDK.
To use it you will need a Vonage account. Sign up for free at vonage.com.
